items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, John Casimir still plays E-flat. [INTERVIEWEE] He's acting?

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I mean, the E-flat clarinet, the E-flat clarinet used to sound just like a baby scream or something, you know? That little horn. And that used to take plenty of effect. That E-flat clarinet took plenty of effect on people. It would sound just like a child screaming or a person screaming, you know? But that B-flat clarinet don't sound like that, you know? It's all more heavy. But that little E-flat clarinet is no longer there. And boy, they would think it would sound like somebody screaming. And it…
Well, John Casimir still plays E-flat.
